activeMission.title: SEIS Capability Activation Hub
activeMission.purpose: Connect usable SEIS apps, skills, plugins, MCPs, GitHub publication, cloud actions, and server handoff into one mission-routed activation hub.
scope: mission-routed skill, plugin, app, and MCP bridge
nonScope: server upload without UIX_UPLOAD_HOST, UIX_UPLOAD_USER, and UIX_UPLOAD_PATH
remote writes without auth, deployment readiness, and mission approval
adding dependencies only to imply capability breadth
validation: capability activation hub includes live MCP runtime, registry, connector matrix, plugin skill, cloud, and shipment sources
Codex cloud config exposes a read-only capability activation hub action
token routing maps capability activation hub files
activeMission.rollback: Revert SEIS-M015 capability activation hub snapshot, checker, docs, server endpoint, cloud config action, and routing entry without touching app UI.
completionCriteria: capability activation hub exists and validates
server endpoint returns the activation hub snapshot
quality gate includes capability activation hub validation
usable apps, skills, plugins, and MCP surfaces are connected through mission routing
GitHub UIXAppTTR receives the committed update
